  2918	## IndexedCone (narrower result: abstract ground family; identification with the physical wave family not formalized)
  2919	
  2920	Formalizes `L:raw-block-indexed-cone` (`notes/integrated_raw_block_lower.tex`
  2921	at `a284420`, lines 232-335) with its display
  2922	`E:raw-block-positive-product`: for `0 < rho < 1/2` there are an integer
  2923	`B >= 1` and `omega, eps_op > 0`, and `c_* = a_* j_*/4 > 0`, such that the
  2924	product lower bound holds for every `N >= 1`, every `omega`-adjacent chain in
  2925	`I = [0,1]` and every operator family `eps_op`-close to the block flows. The
  2926	whole conclusion is proved, including the exact constant
  2927	`c_* = a_* j_*/4`. The lemma uses the ground family of
  2928	`S:compact-mean-family` (`notes/integrated_compact_mean_family.tex`, the
  2929	C16 results), which is not formalized; its outputs are supplied as ONE
  2930	hypothesis structure `GroundFamily F` over an arbitrary real normed space
  2931	`F`, with these fields (TeX lines at `a284420`):
  2932	
  2933	- `P`, `e`, `ell`, `lam`: the flows `P_sigma(t)` (line 17,
  2934	  `E:compact-F-block`), the growing vectors `e_sigma` and duals
  2935	  `ell_sigma` (`E:compact-F-projection`, lines 270-272) and the rates
  2936	  `lambda_sigma` (`P:compact-ground-family`, line 48); `e0` and `obs` are
  2937	  the data `e_0` and the bounded observable `O_phi`
  2938	  (`S:actual-raw-block-lower`, lines 16-17); `d0` is the gap `d_0` (`E:compact-rate-gap`).
  2939	- `lam_pos`: `lambda_sigma > 0` on `I`, a weakening of
  2940	  `sqrt(eps) <= lambda_sigma` in `E:compact-rate-gap` (line 51).
  2941	- `ell_e`, `P_Pi`, `Pi_P`: `ell_sigma(e_sigma) = 1` and
  2942	  `P_sigma(t) Pi_sigma = Pi_sigma P_sigma(t) = e^(lambda_sigma t) Pi_sigma`
  2943	  for `t >= 0`, exactly `E:compact-F-eigen` (lines 277-281), with
  2944	  `Pi_sigma = e_sigma ell_sigma`.
  2945	- `d0_pos`, `normalized_complement`: `d_0 > 0` and, for every
  2946	  `0 < eta < d_0`, a `C` with
  2947	  `||e^(-lambda_sigma t) P_sigma(t) Q_sigma|| <= C e^(-eta t)` for all
  2948	  `sigma` in `I` and `t >= 0`, exactly `E:compact-normalized-complement`
  2949	  (`P:compact-F-complement`, lines 344-348). `d_0` is abstract: its
  2950	  identification with `inf_I(lambda_sigma - mu_sigma)` is not needed.
  2951	- `e_cont`, `ell_cont`: norm continuity of `sigma -> e_sigma` and
  2952	  `sigma -> ell_sigma` on `I` (`P:compact-F-projection`, lines 275-276).
  2953	  Continuity and uniform boundedness of `Pi_sigma`, and boundedness of
  2954	  `e`, `ell`, are derived (`Pi_bounded_continuous`), not assumed.
  2955	- `margin_ell`, `margin_obs`: `0 < inf_I ell_sigma(e_0)` and
  2956	  `0 < inf_I O_phi(e_sigma)`, exactly `E:compact-positive-margins`
  2957	  (lines 283-286).
  2958	
  2959	Every field is a displayed conclusion of `P:compact-ground-family`,
  2960	`P:compact-F-projection` or `P:compact-F-complement`, or a weakening of one,
  2961	so the structure is no stronger than C16. `scalarFamily` shows it is
  2962	satisfiable. The proof is the TeX cone induction (entrance, rebase, full
  2963	block, terminal) with the TeX's order of constant choices.
  2964	`ConeConstants` records constants satisfying relaxed, sufficient versions
  2965	of the TeX's inequalities (lines 254-281): the margins `a`, `j` are any
  2966	positive lower bounds of `ell_sigma(e_0)` and `O_phi(e_sigma)` on `I` (not
  2967	necessarily the infima `a_*`, `j_*`), `C_gap`, `eta_gap`, `nu` need only be
  2968	`>= 0` (the TeX takes `C_gap >= 1`, `eta_gap > 0`, `nu > 0`), and `M_e`,
  2969	`M_ell`, `M_P`, `H` are any nonnegative bounds (the TeX takes
  2970	`max(1, sup)`). `positive_product_of_constants` proves the product bound
  2971	for any such constants, with `c_* = a j/4`, and `exists_coneConstants`
  2972	constructs them with the TeX's choices where needed (`C_gap >= 1`,
  2973	`eta_gap = d_0/2`, positive `nu`) and with `a = a_*` and `j = j_*`; the
